defaults: Supported locale mappings fall back to English; opening is attempted only if plain DB has bytes or .gz decompression succeeds.
effects: Constructor stores DB path and locale-derived language; if the plain DB has bytes or gzip decompression succeeds, it opens MMDB. Decompress requires non-empty `.gz`; decompression exceptions return false. MMDB open errors free/null the allocated handle. `update` closes first then decompresses and reopens, so failure leaves database closed. `getCountry` returns empty without open database, on address/MMDB errors, absent record, missing/invalid non-UTF8 fields; otherwise formats COUNTRY_FORMAT with 2code, continent, engname, name/officialname substitutions. Locale map supports listed locales and defaults to English. Destructor closes/frees handle.
